script_text: This week, Mercury — your ruling planet as an Air sign — fires a tense square to Saturn in your 7th House of Partnerships, and everything you thought was stable gets tested. Monday through Wednesday, Venus trines Jupiter in your 10th House of Career, making this your power window for interviews, negotiations, and public recognition — move decisively. Wednesday into Thursday, Venus enters your 5th House of Romance, flipping career energy into something deeply personal. A surprise flirtation or rekindled connection is written in the stars. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon sextiles Mercury on Friday, sharpening intuition for weekend social moves and creative projects. Best day? Wednesday — Venus trine Jupiter in your 10th House lays opportunity at your feet. Worst day? Monday — that Mercury-Saturn square breeds miscommunication with a boss or partner. Send that pitch this week and trust your Mercury instincts. Follow for daily updates.
